directAnswer: To record your screen on an iPhone, enable the Screen Recording feature in Settings, then use the Control Center to start recording.
summary: Screen recording on iPhone is a straightforward process that allows you to capture video of your screen activities.

sections.heading: Setting Up Screen Recording
sections.body: First, ensure that the Screen Recording feature is added to your Control Center. Go to Settings > Control Center > Customize Controls, then tap the '+' next to Screen Recording.

sections.heading: Starting a Screen Recording
sections.body: To start recording, swipe down from the top-right corner (iPhone X and later) or swipe up from the bottom of the screen (iPhone 8 and earlier) to access the Control Center, then tap the Screen Recording button.

sections.heading: Stopping and Saving Your Recording
sections.body: To stop recording, tap the red status bar at the top of your screen and select 'Stop.' The recording will be saved to your Photos app.

steps.title: Enable Screen Recording
steps.detail: Go to Settings > Control Center > Customize Controls, then tap the '+' next to Screen Recording.

steps.title: Access Control Center
steps.detail: Swipe down from the top-right corner (iPhone X and later) or swipe up from the bottom (iPhone 8 and earlier).

steps.title: Start Recording
steps.detail: Tap the Screen Recording button in the Control Center.

steps.title: Stop Recording
steps.detail: Tap the red status bar and select 'Stop' to save your recording.

faqs.question: Can I record audio while screen recording?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can record audio by long-pressing the Screen Recording button in the Control Center and tapping the microphone icon to turn it on.

faqs.question: Is there a time limit for screen recordings?
faqs.answer: No, there is no specific time limit for screen recordings on iPhone, but storage space may affect the duration.

faqs.question: Where can I find my recorded videos?
faqs.answer: Your recorded videos are saved in the Photos app under the 'Videos' album.

caveats: Screen recording may not be available on devices running iOS versions prior to iOS 11.
